in_hebrew.name: נִכֹלָי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'kol' which means 'voice' and 'lai' meaning 'to God'. Thus, Nikolai means 'people of the voice of God' or 'people who belong to God'. It is not a name found in the Hebrew Bible.

in_greek.name: Νικόλαος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Nikolai in Greek is derived from the words 'nikos' meaning 'victory' and 'laos' meaning 'people'. Thus, Nikolai means 'victory of the people'.

in_latin.name: Nicolaus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nikolai in Latin is a translation of the Greek name 'Nikolaus', which means 'victory of the people'.

in_english.name: Nikolai
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nikolai in English is a direct transcription of the Greek and Latin names, which mean 'victory of the people'.

biblical_reference.note: The name Nikolai is not found in the Bible.

saint_reference.note: Saint Nikolai of Myra, also known as Saint Nicholas, is a famous Christian saint renowned for his generosity and kindness. He is the patron saint of sailors, children, merchants, and students.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Nicholas is a revered saint in the Christian tradition, particularly in the Eastern Orthodox and Catholic Churches. He is famously known as the one who delivers gifts anonymously on December 6th, a precursor to Santa Claus. This cultural impact of encouraging selflessness, giving, and anonymity has continued to inspire acts of kindness and goodwill throughout generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nikolai holds spiritual meaning as it is derived from Saint Nicholas, who embodies the Christian values of love, kindness, and generosity. These virtues serve as a reminder to live a life in service to others and to show compassion and goodwill towards all people- aligning with the belief of putting others before oneself, as Jesus did.

name_in_real_life.story: Sarah Nikolai, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Nikolai meaning "People of the people" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
